fetch_all_models: fetch a dictionary of all available Hugging Face models organized by task type including text, image, and tabular models
get_sorted_models: filter and sort a list of Hugging Face model objects by download count in descending order excluding private models
fetch_text_classification_models: fetch and sort text classification and fill-mask models from the Hugging Face hub by downloads with trending models first
fetch_llm_models: fetch and sort text generation LLM models from the Hugging Face hub by downloads with trending models first
fetch_image_classification_models: fetch and sort image classification models from the Hugging Face hub by downloads with trending models first
